CustomField.description: The person waiting on this file: whoever uploaded it in Trade Review or clicked Load file. When reading, matching or loading finishes, they get a Trade View bell notification and the field is cleared, so each wait is notified once. Blank for files the push job sends.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Who gets a notification when this file's background work finishes. Set by the system.
CustomField.label: Notify User
